title: Evidgate accepted a11y violations
description: One entry per accepted axe violation. Scans fail on any violation no entry covers, and an entry only covers its own rule id on the element its selector names.

$schema.description: Relative reference to this schema file; the shipped list carries it.

exceptions.description: Empty when the product is clean; every entry expires at its review-by date.

rule.description: axe-core rule id, for example color-contrast.

selector.description: The reported target selector, or the path it ends with at a step boundary; a bare last step covers every element with that leaf.

reason.description: Why the violation is accepted, and what the real fix is.

owner.description: The person or role accountable for the fix.

review-by.description: Last day the entry may stay: YYYY-MM-DD, at most 90 days after it was added.
